name: postgres-mcp
description: Adds Google's MCP Toolbox for Databases with its prebuilt PostgreSQL tools for schema inspection, SQL queries, and health and performance views. Sessions start with default_transaction_read_only on, so writes fail by default; this is a session default that SQL can turn off, not a permission boundary, so connect with a read-only database role. Ave asks for the database password as a secret: passwordless trust or peer logins are not supported, and a password with YAML-special characters ({, *, a colon followed by a space, or a space followed by #) can break or truncate Toolbox's config. From 1.15.0 it replaces the archived reference server: set POSTGRES_HOST, POSTGRES_PORT, POSTGRES_DATABASE and POSTGRES_USER instead of a connection URL. Toolbox ships no Linux arm64 build.
